title: 第17章 意外频发第18章 暗流涌动
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
早上，准点醒来。
冯睦习惯性的感受了一下胸口的阴冷，那股阴冷已经跟随肋骨和脊柱，笼罩了上半身的躯干，正在向臂膀延伸。
昨天用力拉伤的臂膀，此刻就能感受到丝丝凉意的透出，没那么疼了。
“覆盖面大概又长了一指节的长度。”冯睦心想。
穿衣洗漱，拢共没用两分钟。
并且，久违的临幸了马桶，有种重新做回人的舒爽感。
“看来一半饭一半铁的比例是合适的，昨晚没有想进化成厄尸的饥饿感了。”
冯睦看向镜子里的脸，比一周前有些变化。
脸上掉了点肉，下巴透出点棱角，肤色尤其变白了些，显得气质变冷了些。
吃饭，出门，骑车，嘴里含着铁珠子，时不时就吞咽下去一颗。
车胎在地上擦出划痕，紧急刹住。
抬头，冯睦看向面前几个拦路的半大小子。
个头不高，脸黑黝黝的，穿着破烂，隔着一米空气都被染成馊臭味儿。
冯睦皱眉：“你们要干嘛？”
“饭！”最黑的高个子走出来，干哑着声音，“你前两天给了一盒饭。”
冯睦有点回忆起来，眼前这几个应该就是当时跟野狗抢食的拾荒者。
冯睦没吭声，从自行车上下来，单手塞进裤兜攥住个冰冷的触感，眼中满是警惕。
“饭，怎么没了，还要！”
另一个半大小子像是太久没跟人说过话，一句话磕巴了三次牙齿，眼神却格外凶狠的盯着冯睦。
冯睦听懂了，只觉荒诞。

他冷着脸：“没了。”
几个半大小子互视一眼，围了上来。
黑高个从怀里掏出一个空的食盒，还给冯睦同时说：“明早，填满带来。”
冯睦舌尖舔舔嘴里的铁珠子，心头卸掉荒诞，升起冷酷，眼神也阴沉起来。
“错了，浪费食物不是错，把食物施舍别人才是错误。”
“在人吃人的世界，善良或许会引来感激，但更可能被当成食物分食掉。”
冯睦心思电转，对这个世界的底色有了更深刻的认知。
他接过食盒，用力一抛扔到腐臭的垃圾桶里，恶声道：“我这没有，想吃就去垃圾桶里刨。”
“你！”
黑高个暴怒，伸手就抓向自行车，周围半大小子也都争先恐后的乌漆墨黑的手抓向冯睦的衣服。
冯睦抽出匕首，绕圈一划。
“拿开你们的狗爪子。”冯睦冷声喝道，匕首上甩出一道血渍，也不知划破了哪只狗爪子。
围拢过来的手全部散开，一群半大小子齐刷刷退后，都用恶毒的眼神盯过来。
冯睦感受到头皮发麻，但他脸上没有露出半分怯懦，反而攥紧匕首，在每个人脸前停顿一瞬。
他调整呼吸，让声音少些波澜，平静却阴冷的威胁。
“你们可以一起冲上来，但是，一定会有人被我捅伤。”
“被捅伤的人，也许今天不会死，但过两天伤口会腐烂，再然后会躺进垃圾桶里，成为野狗的食物。”
“你们不会觉得受伤了，不会被抛弃吧。”
content_en:
In the morning, wake up on time.
Feng Mu habitually felt the coldness in his chest. The coldness had followed his ribs and spine, enveloped his upper body, and was extending to his arms.
The arm that was strained yesterday can feel the slightest chill now, and it doesn't hurt so much anymore.
"The coverage is probably longer than the length of a knuckle." Feng Mu thought to himself.
It only took less than two minutes to get dressed and wash up.
Moreover, after visiting the toilet for a long time, I felt comfortable and felt like a human being again.
"It seems that the ratio of half rice and half iron is appropriate. I didn't feel hungry enough to evolve into an evil corpse last night."
Feng Mu looked at his face in the mirror, which was slightly different from a week ago.
The face has lost some flesh, the chin has become a little more angular, the skin color has become especially whiter, and the temperament has become colder.
When eating, going out, or riding a bicycle, I would hold iron beads in my mouth and swallow one from time to time.
The tire scraped scratches on the ground and the car came to an emergency stop.
Looking up, Feng Mu looked at the few young men blocking the road in front of him.
He was short in stature, with a swarthy face, and was dressed in tatters. The air was stained with a rancid smell even one meter away.
Feng Mu frowned: "What do you want to do?"
"Food!" The tallest man with the darkest color came out with a hoarse voice, "You gave me a box of lunch two days ago."
Feng Mu recalled that the few scavengers in front of him should be the scavengers who were competing with wild dogs for food.
Feng Mu didn't say a word, got off the bicycle, put one hand into his trouser pocket and grasped the cold touch, his eyes full of vigilance.
"Why is the rice gone? I still need more!"
The other half-grown boy seemed to have not spoken to anyone for a long time. He chatted his teeth three times in one sentence, but his eyes were staring at Feng Mu with a particularly fierce look.
Feng Mu understood and found it absurd.
He said with a cold face: "No more."
Several half-grown men looked at each other and gathered around.
The tall black man took out an empty food box from his arms, gave it back to Feng Mu and said at the same time: "Tomorrow morning, fill it up and bring it."
Feng Mu licked the iron beads in his mouth with the tip of his tongue. The absurdity was removed from his mind, and he became cold and his eyes became gloomy.
"Wrong. It's not wrong to waste food. It's wrong to give food to others."
"In a world where people cannibalize people, kindness may attract gratitude, but it is more likely to be eaten as food."
Feng Mu's mind was spinning, and he had a deeper understanding of the background of this world.
He took the food box, threw it into the rancid trash can, and said angrily: "I don't have any here. If you want to eat, go dig in the trash can."
"You!"
The tall black man was furious and reached out to grab the bicycle. The young men around him were also scrambling to grab Feng Mu's clothes with their pitch-black hands.
Feng Mu drew out his dagger and made a circle stroke.
"Take your dog's paws away." Feng Mu shouted coldly, and a blood stain appeared on the dagger. It was not known which dog's paw was scratched.
All the hands that gathered around him dispersed, and a group of half-grown men stepped back together, all staring at them with vicious eyes.
Feng Mu felt his scalp numb, but there was no hint of cowardice on his face. Instead, he clenched the dagger tightly and paused for a moment in front of everyone's face.
He adjusted his breathing to make his voice less choppy and calm but coldly threatening.
"You can rush up together, but someone will definitely be stabbed by me."
"The person who was stabbed may not die today, but the wound will rot in two days, and then he will lie in the trash can and become food for wild dogs."
"You don't feel hurt or abandoned."
